in_sanskrit.name: Keyansh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God's treasure
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Keyansh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Keyansh is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Kay' meaning God and 'Ansh' meaning treasure. This name signifies that the bearer of this name is a God's treasure. In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu is often depicted as having a treasure (Ansh) of the universe in his navel.
